assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the PR-204 denial
CPT 93247 is long-term continuous ECG monitoring
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a significant history of transient ischemic attacks
The diagnosis code I48.0 is assigned
The diagnosis code G45.9 is assigned
The diagnosis code Z86.73 is assigned
There is concern for intermittent arrhythmia contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The ordered study directly addresses the documented indication
The appeal requests reconsideration of the coverage determination on the basis of clinical necessity
